hexAllowed.why: Server-rendered standalone HTML that never loads the SPA stylesheet.
Google's sign-in mark. Its four values are fixed by Google's brand guidelines for third-party sign-in buttons; they are not our tokens and must not be re-tinted.

Each site config's brand.themeColor fills index.html's theme-color meta tag, which the browser reads before any CSS loads, so it must be a literal; the checker allows the same literal in a meta tag. The configs hold no other colour.
